event: Nala stays still and listens as the woman above starts humming a slow, rocking tune.
The tune has no words: the same few lines over and over, rising and falling like a cradle.
Nala hums along in her head, fitting Sa, vo, reth to it, one sound to a note.
The three sounds sit in the tune; each time round, the shape comes easier to her.
Partway through a line the woman hums Sa-vo-reth herself, right where Nala put it.
A door opens and a second woman's voice comes in, quick; the humming stops mid-line.
